meaning: ST I q.11 a.3 co., second proof, for the prima via's mover: two first movers moved by none would each have every perfection and so agree in every act; things that agree in every act are one. The Comparator config also verifies premisesJointlySatisfiable: the prima via premises and all premises of the #165 results hold together in a model where none of them is vacuous.
